subject.title: Feature - Implement paid certificate or badge for a manual review and approval of skills

question: Should ClawHub offer a paid expedited human-review certificate for skills, and if so what assurance scope should the badge publicly claim?
rationale: This affects user trust, security assurances, staff operations, payment/refund/SLA policy, and existing verification semantics, so automation should not define the product contract.

options.title: Define policy before implementation
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers define scope, criteria, expiry, revocation, auditability, payment handling, and public wording before any code PR.

options.title: Fold into existing verification work
options.body: Treat paid review as out of scope and route trust signaling through Official publisher, scan, and verification-tier work instead.

options.title: Reject paid review badges
options.body: Close the direction if paid review would create unacceptable trust, fairness, or operations risk for ClawHub.

recommendation.title: Define policy before implementation
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers define scope, criteria, expiry, revocation, auditability, payment handling, and public wording before any code PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The current trust and badge primitives are blame-backed to this contributor, making them the best first routing owner for the policy question.
